## English

### New Features
- Added Korean throughout the app, including native menus and file dialogs, with automatic selection on Korean systems.
- Added a Korean README and website, including Korean screenshots and download information.

## 简体中文

### 新功能
- 软件新增韩语，覆盖界面、原生菜单和文件对话框，并支持在韩语系统上自动选用。
- 新增韩语 README 和官网页面，提供韩语截图与下载说明。
